segments.src: Many companies also support industry standards for attaching "content credentials," or provenance data, to files, though such data can be stripped when a file is re-uploaded or screenshotted.
segments.tr: Banyak perusahaan juga mendukung standar industri untuk melampirkan "kredensial konten", atau data asal, ke file, meskipun data tersebut dapat dihapus saat file diunggah ulang atau diambil tangkapan layarnya.

segments.src: **Election officials.** State and local election offices publish accurate voting information and often run "rumor control" pages that address common false claims.
segments.tr: **Pejabat pemilu.** Kantor pemilu negara bagian dan lokal menerbitkan informasi pemungutan suara yang akurat dan sering menjalankan halaman "pengendalian rumor" yang membahas klaim palsu umum.

segments.src: Many states have also passed laws that require disclosure of, or restrict, deceptive synthetic media in election communications, particularly close to an election.
segments.tr: Banyak negara bagian juga telah mengesahkan undang-undang yang mewajibkan pengungkapan, atau membatasi, media sintetis yang menipu dalam komunikasi pemilu, terutama menjelang pemilu.

segments.src: The details differ from state to state, and some of these laws face legal challenges, so rules are not uniform nationwide.
segments.tr: Detailnya berbeda dari satu negara bagian ke negara bagian lain, dan beberapa undang-undang ini menghadapi tantangan hukum, sehingga aturan tidak seragam secara nasional.

segments.src: **Regulators.** The Federal Communications Commission has said that AI-generated voices in robocalls are covered by existing telephone consumer protection rules.
segments.tr: **Regulator.** Komisi Komunikasi Federal telah mengatakan bahwa suara buatan AI dalam robocall dicakup oleh aturan perlindungan konsumen telepon yang ada.

segments.src: Beyond that, federal rules on AI in political advertising remain a subject of ongoing debate.
segments.tr: Di luar itu, aturan federal tentang AI dalam iklan politik tetap menjadi subjek perdebatan yang sedang berlangsung.

segments.src: ## How to spot manipulated content
segments.tr: ## Cara mengenali konten yang dimanipulasi

segments.src: No single test is foolproof, and the best fakes may look and sound flawless.
segments.tr: Tidak ada satu pun tes yang sepenuhnya aman, dan pemalsuan terbaik mungkin terlihat dan terdengar sempurna.

segments.src: Treat the following as warning signs, not proof.
segments.tr: Perlakukan hal berikut sebagai tanda peringatan, bukan bukti.

segments.src: **Check the context first**
segments.tr: **Periksa konteksnya terlebih dahulu**

segments.src: - **Who posted it?** An unknown or newly created account sharing a "leaked" or "shocking" clip deserves more caution than a verified outlet or official channel.
segments.tr: - **Siapa yang mempostingnya?** Akun yang tidak dikenal atau baru dibuat yang membagikan klip "bocor" atau "mengejutkan" layak mendapatkan lebih banyak kehati-hatian daripada outlet terverifikasi atau saluran resmi.

segments.src: - **Is there an original source?** Real events usually have multiple independent records: several camera angles, news coverage, official transcripts.
segments.tr: - **Apakah ada sumber asli?** Peristiwa nyata biasanya memiliki beberapa catatan independen: beberapa sudut kamera, liputan berita, transkrip resmi.

segments.src: - **Does it trigger a strong emotion?** Content built to make you angry or afraid, and to be shared immediately, is a common pattern for misleading posts.
segments.tr: - **Apakah itu memicu emosi yang kuat?** Konten yang dibangun untuk membuat Anda marah atau takut, dan untuk segera dibagikan, adalah pola umum untuk postingan yang menyesatkan.

segments.src: - **Is the timing suspicious?** Explosive material that appears just before voting begins, with no time for checking, is a red flag.
segments.tr: - **Apakah waktunya mencurigakan?** Materi eksplosif yang muncul tepat sebelum pemungutan suara dimulai, tanpa waktu untuk memeriksa, adalah bendera merah.

segments.src: **Look and listen closely**
segments.tr: **Lihat dan dengarkan baik-baik**

segments.src: - **Audio:** flat or oddly even tone, unnatural pauses, odd breathing, background noise that does not match the setting, or a voice that sounds slightly "too clean."
segments.tr: - **Audio:** nada datar atau anehnya rata, jeda yang tidak wajar, pernapasan yang aneh, kebisingan latar belakang yang tidak cocok dengan pengaturan, atau suara yang terdengar sedikit "terlalu bersih".

segments.src: - **Video:** mouth movements that do not line up with speech, blurry edges around the face or hair, inconsistent lighting, odd blinking, or hands and teeth that look distorted.
segments.tr: - **Video:** gerakan mulut yang tidak selaras dengan ucapan, tepi yang kabur di sekitar wajah atau rambut, pencahayaan yang tidak konsisten, kedipan yang aneh, atau tangan dan gigi yang terlihat terdistorsi.

segments.src: - **Images:** garbled text on signs, extra or merged fingers, strange reflections, or repeated patterns in crowds.
segments.tr: - **Gambar:** teks yang kacau pada tanda, jari tambahan atau bergabung, pantulan aneh, atau pola berulang di kerumunan.

segments.src: - **Compression and cropping:** low-quality or heavily cropped clips can hide flaws, which is sometimes the point.
segments.tr: - **Kompresi dan pemotongan:** klip berkualitas rendah atau dipotong berat dapat menyembunyikan kekurangan, yang terkadang menjadi tujuannya.

segments.src: **Do a quick verification**
segments.tr: **Lakukan verifikasi cepat**

segments.src: - Run a reverse image search on a still frame to see where else the image has appeared.
segments.tr: - Jalankan pencarian gambar terbalik pada bingkai diam untuk melihat di mana lagi gambar tersebut muncul.

segments.src: - Search for the quote or event along with the names of established news outlets or fact-checking organizations.
segments.tr: - Cari kutipan atau peristiwa beserta nama outlet berita mapan atau organisasi pemeriksa fakta.

segments.src: - Look for the full, unedited video rather than a short excerpt.
segments.tr: - Cari video lengkap yang tidak diedit alih-alih kutipan singkat.

segments.src: - Check whether the candidate's official website or verified social accounts have commented.
segments.tr: - Periksa apakah situs web resmi kandidat atau akun sosial terverifikasi telah berkomentar.

segments.src: ## Where to verify claims
segments.tr: ## Di mana memverifikasi klaim

segments.src: - **Your state or county election office.** For anything about registration, voting dates, polling places, mail ballots or ID requirements, go directly to your official state or local election website. Type the address yourself or use a trusted bookmark rather than clicking a link in a message.
segments.tr: - **Kantor pemilu negara bagian atau kabupaten Anda.** Untuk apa pun tentang pendaftaran, tanggal pemungutan suara, tempat pemungutan suara, surat suara pos, atau persyaratan ID, buka langsung situs web pemilu resmi negara bagian atau lokal Anda. Ketik alamatnya sendiri atau gunakan penanda yang tepercaya daripada mengklik tautan dalam pesan.

segments.src: - **Vote.gov.** A federal government site that directs you to official state election information.
segments.tr: - **Vote.gov.** Situs web pemerintah federal yang mengarahkan Anda ke informasi pemilu negara bagian resmi.

segments.src: - **Established fact-checking organizations.** Nonpartisan groups such as PolitiFact, FactCheck.org, and the fact-checking teams at major news agencies publish detailed reviews of viral claims.
segments.tr: - **Organisasi pemeriksa fakta mapan.** Kelompok nonpartisan seperti PolitiFact, FactCheck.org, dan tim pemeriksa fakta di kantor berita utama menerbitkan ulasan terperinci tentang klaim viral.

segments.src: - **Wire services and local news.** Outlets such as the Associated Press and Reuters, along with local newsrooms that cover your area, typically confirm claims with multiple sources before publishing.
segments.tr: - **Layanan kabel dan berita lokal.** Outlet seperti Associated Press dan Reuters, bersama dengan ruang berita lokal yang meliput daerah Anda, biasanya mengonfirmasi klaim dengan berbagai sumber sebelum menerbitkan.

segments.src: - **Candidate and campaign channels.** If a quote seems out of character, see whether the candidate or campaign has addressed it on an official page. Keep in mind that a campaign also has an interest in how a story is framed, so compare with independent sources.
segments.tr: - **Saluran kandidat dan kampanye.** Jika sebuah kutipan tampak di luar karakter, lihat apakah kandidat atau kampanye telah membahasnya di halaman resmi. Perhatikan bahwa kampanye juga memiliki kepentingan dalam bagaimana sebuah cerita dibingkai, jadi bandingkan dengan sumber independen.

segments.src: ## A simple habit before you share
segments.tr: ## Kebiasaan sederhana sebelum Anda berbagi

segments.src: Try the **pause, check, then post** routine:
segments.tr: Coba rutin **jeda, periksa, lalu posting**:

segments.src: 1. **Pause.** If something makes you instantly furious, delighted or alarmed, wait a few minutes.
segments.tr: 1. **Jeda.** Jika sesuatu membuat Anda langsung marah, senang, atau khawatir, tunggu beberapa menit.

segments.src: 2. **Check.** Look for the original source and at least one independent confirmation.
segments.tr: 2. **Periksa.** Cari sumber asli dan setidaknya satu konfirmasi independen.

segments.src: 3. **Post responsibly.** If you cannot verify it, do not share it. If you already shared something that turns out to be false, delete it or add a correction so others are not misled.
segments.tr: 3. **Posting secara bertanggung jawab.** Jika Anda tidak dapat memverifikasinya, jangan bagikan. Jika Anda sudah membagikan sesuatu yang ternyata salah, hapus atau tambahkan koreksi agar orang lain tidak disesatkan.

segments.src: ## If you receive a suspicious call, text or message
segments.tr: ## Jika Anda menerima panggilan, teks, atau pesan yang mencurigakan

segments.src: - Do not rely on caller ID, which can be faked.
segments.tr: - Jangan mengandalkan ID penelepon, yang dapat dipalsukan.

segments.src: - Hang up and look up the official phone number or website of the organization the message claims to come from.
segments.tr: - Tutup telepon dan cari nomor telepon resmi atau situs web organisasi yang diklaim sebagai asal pesan.

segments.src: - Never share personal information, passwords or payment details in response to an unexpected political or voting-related message.
segments.tr: - Jangan pernah membagikan informasi pribadi, kata sandi, atau detail pembayaran sebagai tanggapan atas pesan politik atau terkait pemungutan suara yang tidak terduga.

segments.src: - Report misleading voting information to your local election office and to the platform where you saw it.
segments.tr: - Laporkan informasi pemungutan suara yang menyesatkan ke kantor pemilu lokal Anda dan ke platform tempat Anda melihatnya.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: AI-generated media does not mean you can never trust what you see and hear.
segments.tr: Media buatan AI bukan berarti Anda tidak boleh mempercayai apa yang Anda lihat dan dengar.

segments.src: It means that a clip going viral is no longer enough evidence that it is real.
segments.tr: Itu berarti klip yang menjadi viral bukan lagi bukti yang cukup bahwa itu nyata.

segments.src: A few minutes of checking, from the right sources, remains one of the strongest protections voters have.
segments.tr: Beberapa menit pemeriksaan, dari sumber yang tepat, tetap menjadi salah satu perlindungan terkuat yang dimiliki pemilih.

segments.src: As the final weeks of the midterms unfold, being careful about what you share is one practical way to help keep the conversation about the election grounded in facts.
segments.tr: Saat minggu-minggu terakhir pemilu sela berlangsung, berhati-hati dengan apa yang Anda bagikan adalah salah satu cara praktis untuk membantu menjaga percakapan tentang pemilu tetap berakar pada fakta.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and is not legal advice.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini adalah untuk informasi umum dan bukan nasihat hukum.

segments.src: Election rules vary by state, so confirm dates and requirements with your local election office.*
segments.tr: Aturan pemilu bervariasi menurut negara bagian, jadi konfirmasikan tanggal dan persyaratan dengan kantor pemilu lokal Anda.*

ja.title: 偽の音声、本物の投票：AIディープフェイクが中間選挙の最終盤を試す

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3 approaching, voters are seeing more political audio, video and images online than ever.
segments.tr: 11月3日の投票日が近づくにつれ、有権者はオンラインでこれまで以上に多くの政治的な音声、動画、画像を目にするようになっています。

segments.src: Some of it is real.
segments.tr: その一部は本物です。

segments.src: Some of it is made by software that can imitate a person's voice or face in minutes.
segments.tr: また一部は、人の声や顔を数分で模倣できるソフトウェアによって作成されたものです。

segments.src: Campaigns, social platforms and election officials are all working to respond.
segments.tr: 選挙陣営、ソーシャルプラットフォーム、選挙管理当局は皆、これに対応しようと取り組んでいます。

segments.src: Here is what is going on, and what you can do before you share the next clip.
segments.tr: ここでは何が起きているのか、そして次のクリップを共有する前に何ができるのかを解説します。

segments.src: ## Why this problem is growing
segments.tr: ## なぜこの問題が拡大しているのか

segments.src: Synthetic media, often called "deepfakes," is audio, video or imagery generated or altered by artificial intelligence to make someone appear to say or do something they did not.
segments.tr: 「ディープフェイク」と呼ばれることが多い合成メディアとは、人工知能によって生成または改ざんされた音声、動画、画像であり、誰かが実際には言っていないことや行っていないことを言ったり行ったりしているように見せるものです。

segments.src: A few years ago, convincing fakes took specialized skills and expensive equipment.
segments.tr: 数年前までは、説得力のある偽物を作るには専門的なスキルと高価な機材が必要でした。

segments.src: Today, many consumer tools can clone a voice from a short sample or produce a realistic image from a text prompt.
segments.tr: 今日では、多くの消費者向けツールを使って、短いサンプルから声を複製したり、テキストプロンプトからリアルな画像を生成したりすることができます。

segments.src: That lower cost matters in election season for three reasons:
segments.tr: この低コスト化が選挙シーズンにおいて重要である理由は3つあります。

segments.src: - **Speed.** A fake can be made and posted in the time it takes news organizations to confirm whether something is real.
segments.tr: - **スピード。** ニュース機関が何かが本物かどうかを確認している間に、偽物を作成して投稿することができます。

segments.src: - **Volume.** When anyone can make convincing content, the sheer amount of material makes it harder to check every item.
segments.tr: - **量。** 誰でも説得力のあるコンテンツを作成できるため、膨大な量の素材すべてをチェックすることが難しくなっています。

segments.src: - **Doubt.** Real recordings can now be dismissed as "probably AI." Experts sometimes call this the "liar's dividend," and it can erode trust even when nothing has been faked.
segments.tr: - **疑念。** 本物の録音であっても、「おそらくAIだろう」として退けられる可能性があります。専門家はこれを「嘘つきの配当（liar's dividend）」と呼ぶことがあり、何も偽造されていない場合でも信頼を損なう可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What the threat looks like in practice
segments.tr: ## 脅威は実際にはどのようなものか

segments.src: Most manipulated political content falls into a few categories:
segments.tr: 操作された政治的コンテンツのほとんどは、いくつかのカテゴリーに分類されます。

segments.src: 1. **Voice clones in phone calls.** In January 2024, voters in New Hampshire received robocalls using an AI-generated imitation of President Biden's voice that urged them to skip the primary. The episode prompted a federal ruling that AI-generated voices in robocalls fall under existing restrictions on artificial or prerecorded calls.
segments.tr: 1. **電話での音声クローン。** 2024年1月、ニューハンプシャー州の有権者は、バイデン大統領の声をAIで模倣したロボコール（自動音声電話）を受け取り、予備選挙を棄権するよう促されました。この出来事をきっかけに、ロボコールにおけるAI生成音声は、人工的または録音済みの通話に関する既存の規制の対象となるという連邦判決が下されました。

segments.src: 2. **Altered video clips.** Real footage can be edited, slowed down, re-captioned or dubbed with a synthetic voice to change its meaning.
segments.tr: 2. **改ざんされた動画クリップ。** 本物の映像を編集したり、速度を落としたり、字幕を付け替えたり、合成音声で吹き替えたりして、その意味を変えることができます。

segments.src: 3. **Fabricated images.** Realistic pictures of events that never happened, such as crowds, arrests or endorsements, can spread quickly with a convincing caption.
segments.tr: 3. **捏造された画像。** 群衆、逮捕、支持表明など、実際には起こっていない出来事のリアルな画像が、説得力のあるキャプションと共に急速に拡散される可能性があります。

segments.src: 4. **Misleading voting information.** Fake messages about polling hours, locations, deadlines or eligibility can target voters directly, sometimes by text or social media.
segments.tr: 4. **誤解を招く投票情報。** 投票時間、場所、期限、資格に関する偽のメッセージが、テキストメッセージやソーシャルメディアなどを通じて、有権者を直接標的にする可能性があります。

segments.src: 5. **Parody that loses its label.** Satire is a protected and long-standing form of political speech, but a joke clip that is cropped or reposted without context can be mistaken for the real thing.
segments.tr: 5. **ラベルを失ったパロディ。** 風刺は保護された長年の政治的言論の形式ですが、文脈なしに切り取られたり再投稿されたりしたジョーク動画は、本物と誤認される可能性があります。

segments.src: Not every fake is designed to persuade.
segments.tr: すべての偽物が説得を目的としているわけではありません。

segments.src: Some aim simply to confuse people, drain attention or leave them unsure what to believe.
segments.tr: 人々を混乱させたり、注意をそらしたり、何を信じてよいか分からなくさせたりすることだけを目的としているものもあります。

segments.src: ## How campaigns, platforms and officials are responding
segments.tr: ## 選挙陣営、プラットフォーム、当局はどのように対応しているか

segments.src: **Campaigns and parties.** Many campaigns now monitor for false content about their candidates and prepare rapid responses.
segments.tr: **選挙陣営と政党。** 多くの陣営は現在、候補者に関する誤ったコンテンツを監視し、迅速な対応を準備しています。

segments.src: Some publish verified statements and videos on official channels so supporters have a trusted place to check.
segments.tr: 支持者が確認できる信頼できる場所として、公式チャンネルで検証済みの声明や動画を公開しているところもあります。

segments.src: Practices vary, and not every campaign discloses when it uses AI tools in its own materials.
segments.tr: 慣行はさまざまであり、すべての陣営が自らの資料でAIツールを使用していることを開示しているわけではありません。

segments.src: **Platforms.** Major social networks and video sites have introduced policies on manipulated media, including labels for AI-generated content, requirements for creators to disclose realistic synthetic material, and removal of content that misleads people about how to vote.
segments.tr: **プラットフォーム。** 主要なソーシャルネットワークや動画サイトは、操作されたメディアに関するポリシーを導入しています。これには、AI生成コンテンツへのラベル付け、クリエイターに対するリアルな合成素材の開示義務付け、投票方法について誤解を招くコンテンツの削除などが含まれます。

segments.src: Enforcement is uneven, and content often spreads before it is labeled or removed.
segments.tr: 取り締まりは一様ではなく、コンテンツがラベル付けや削除される前に拡散してしまうことがよくあります。

segments.src: Many companies also support industry standards for attaching "content credentials," or provenance data, to files, though such data can be stripped when a file is re-uploaded or screenshotted.
segments.tr: 多くの企業は、ファイルに「コンテンツ認証情報」や来歴データを添付する業界標準を支持していますが、ファイルが再アップロードされたりスクリーンショットを撮られたりすると、そのようなデータが削除されてしまう可能性があります。

segments.src: **Election officials.** State and local election offices publish accurate voting information and often run "rumor control" pages that address common false claims.
segments.tr: **選挙管理当局。** 州や地方の選挙管理事務所は正確な投票情報を公開しており、よくある誤った主張に対処する「噂の管理（rumor control）」ページを運営していることもあります。

segments.src: Many states have also passed laws that require disclosure of, or restrict, deceptive synthetic media in election communications, particularly close to an election.
segments.tr: 多くの州では、特に選挙に近い時期の選挙通信において、欺瞞的な合成メディアの開示を義務付けたり、制限したりする法律も可決しています。

segments.src: The details differ from state to state, and some of these laws face legal challenges, so rules are not uniform nationwide.
segments.tr: 詳細は州によって異なり、これらの法律の一部は法的異議申し立てに直面しているため、ルールは全国で統一されていません。

segments.src: **Regulators.** The Federal Communications Commission has said that AI-generated voices in robocalls are covered by existing telephone consumer protection rules.
segments.tr: **規制当局。** 連邦通信委員会（FCC）は、ロボコールにおけるAI生成音声は、既存の電話消費者保護規則の対象であると述べています。

segments.src: Beyond that, federal rules on AI in political advertising remain a subject of ongoing debate.
segments.tr: それ以上に、政治広告におけるAIに関する連邦規則は、現在も議論の対象となっています。

segments.src: ## How to spot manipulated content
segments.tr: ## 操作されたコンテンツを見抜く方法

segments.src: No single test is foolproof, and the best fakes may look and sound flawless.
segments.tr: 完璧なテストは存在せず、最高の偽物は見た目も音も完璧かもしれません。

segments.src: Treat the following as warning signs, not proof.
segments.tr: 以下を証拠ではなく、警告の兆候として扱ってください。

segments.src: **Check the context first**
segments.tr: **まずは文脈を確認する**

segments.src: - **Who posted it?** An unknown or newly created account sharing a "leaked" or "shocking" clip deserves more caution than a verified outlet or official channel.
segments.tr: - **誰が投稿したか？** 「リーク」や「衝撃的」なクリップを共有している未知のアカウントや作成されたばかりのアカウントは、検証済みのメディアや公式チャンネルよりも注意が必要です。

segments.src: - **Is there an original source?** Real events usually have multiple independent records: several camera angles, news coverage, official transcripts.
segments.tr: - **元のソースはあるか？** 本物の出来事には通常、複数の独立した記録があります。複数のカメラアングル、ニュース報道、公式の記録などです。

segments.src: - **Does it trigger a strong emotion?** Content built to make you angry or afraid, and to be shared immediately, is a common pattern for misleading posts.
segments.tr: - **強い感情を刺激するか？** 怒りや恐怖を感じさせ、すぐに共有させるように作られたコンテンツは、誤解を招く投稿の典型的なパターンです。

segments.src: - **Is the timing suspicious?** Explosive material that appears just before voting begins, with no time for checking, is a red flag.
segments.tr: - **タイミングは疑わしくないか？** 投票開始直前に現れる爆発的な素材で、確認する時間がないものは危険信号です。

segments.src: **Look and listen closely**
segments.tr: **よく見て、よく聞く**

segments.src: - **Audio:** flat or oddly even tone, unnatural pauses, odd breathing, background noise that does not match the setting, or a voice that sounds slightly "too clean."
segments.tr: - **音声：** 平坦または不自然に均一なトーン、不自然な間、奇妙な呼吸音、設定と一致しない背景ノイズ、または「きれいすぎる」ように聞こえる声。

segments.src: - **Video:** mouth movements that do not line up with speech, blurry edges around the face or hair, inconsistent lighting, odd blinking, or hands and teeth that look distorted.
segments.tr: - **動画：** 話し方と一致しない口の動き、顔や髪の周りのぼやけたエッジ、一貫性のない照明、奇妙な瞬き、または歪んで見える手や歯。

segments.src: - **Images:** garbled text on signs, extra or merged fingers, strange reflections, or repeated patterns in crowds.
segments.tr: - **画像：** 看板の文字化け、指が多すぎる、または融合している、奇妙な反射、または群衆の中の繰り返されるパターン。

segments.src: - **Compression and cropping:** low-quality or heavily cropped clips can hide flaws, which is sometimes the point.
segments.tr: - **圧縮とトリミング：** 低品質または大幅にトリミングされたクリップは欠陥を隠すことができ、それが目的である場合もあります。

segments.src: **Do a quick verification**
segments.tr: **簡単な検証を行う**

segments.src: - Run a reverse image search on a still frame to see where else the image has appeared.
segments.tr: - 静止画で逆画像検索を実行し、その画像が他にどこで表示されているかを確認します。

segments.src: - Search for the quote or event along with the names of established news outlets or fact-checking organizations.
segments.tr: - 引用や出来事を、確立されたニュースメディアやファクトチェック組織の名前と一緒に検索します。

segments.src: - Look for the full, unedited video rather than a short excerpt.
segments.tr: - 短い抜粋ではなく、編集されていない完全な動画を探します。

segments.src: - Check whether the candidate's official website or verified social accounts have commented.
segments.tr: - 候補者の公式ウェブサイトや検証済みのソーシャルアカウントがコメントしているか確認します。

segments.src: ## Where to verify claims
segments.tr: ## 主張を検証する場所

segments.src: - **Your state or county election office.** For anything about registration, voting dates, polling places, mail ballots or ID requirements, go directly to your official state or local election website. Type the address yourself or use a trusted bookmark rather than clicking a link in a message.
segments.tr: - **州または郡の選挙管理事務所。** 登録、投票日、投票所、郵便投票、身分証明書の要件については、公式の州または地方の選挙ウェブサイトに直接アクセスしてください。メッセージ内のリンクをクリックするのではなく、アドレスを自分で入力するか、信頼できるブックマークを使用してください。

segments.src: - **Vote.gov.** A federal government site that directs you to official state election information.
segments.tr: - **Vote.gov。** 公式の州の選挙情報に案内する連邦政府のサイト。

segments.src: - **Established fact-checking organizations.** Nonpartisan groups such as PolitiFact, FactCheck.org, and the fact-checking teams at major news agencies publish detailed reviews of viral claims.
segments.tr: - **確立されたファクトチェック組織。** PolitiFact、FactCheck.org、主要ニュース機関のファクトチェックチームなどの非党派グループは、バイラルな主張の詳細なレビューを公開しています。

segments.src: - **Wire services and local news.** Outlets such as the Associated Press and Reuters, along with local newsrooms that cover your area, typically confirm claims with multiple sources before publishing.
segments.tr: - **通信社と地方ニュース。** Associated PressやReutersなどのメディア、およびあなたの地域をカバーする地方のニュース編集室は、通常、公開前に複数のソースで主張を確認します。

segments.src: - **Candidate and campaign channels.** If a quote seems out of character, see whether the candidate or campaign has addressed it on an official page. Keep in mind that a campaign also has an interest in how a story is framed, so compare with independent sources.
segments.tr: - **候補者と陣営のチャンネル。** 引用がらしくない場合は、候補者や陣営が公式ページでそれに対処しているか確認してください。陣営もストーリーの構成方法に関心を持っていることを念頭に置き、独立したソースと比較してください。

segments.src: ## A simple habit before you share
segments.tr: ## 共有する前の簡単な習慣

segments.src: Try the **pause, check, then post** routine:
segments.tr: **一時停止、確認、そして投稿**のルーチンを試してください：

segments.src: 1. **Pause.** If something makes you instantly furious, delighted or alarmed, wait a few minutes.
segments.tr: 1. **一時停止。** 何かを見てすぐに激怒したり、喜んだり、驚いたりした場合は、数分待ってください。

segments.src: 2. **Check.** Look for the original source and at least one independent confirmation.
segments.tr: 2. **確認。** 元のソースと、少なくとも1つの独立した確認を探してください。

segments.src: 3. **Post responsibly.** If you cannot verify it, do not share it. If you already shared something that turns out to be false, delete it or add a correction so others are not misled.
segments.tr: 3. **責任を持って投稿。** 検証できない場合は、共有しないでください。すでに共有したものが偽物だと判明した場合は、削除するか訂正を加えて、他の人が誤解しないようにしてください。

segments.src: ## If you receive a suspicious call, text or message
segments.tr: ## 疑わしい電話、テキスト、メッセージを受け取った場合

segments.src: - Do not rely on caller ID, which can be faked.
segments.tr: - 発信者番号通知は偽造される可能性があるため、頼らないでください。

segments.src: - Hang up and look up the official phone number or website of the organization the message claims to come from.
segments.tr: - 電話を切り、メッセージの送信元と主張する組織の公式電話番号またはウェブサイトを調べてください。

segments.src: - Never share personal information, passwords or payment details in response to an unexpected political or voting-related message.
segments.tr: - 予期しない政治や投票関連のメッセージに応答して、個人情報、パスワード、支払い詳細を絶対に共有しないでください。

segments.src: - Report misleading voting information to your local election office and to the platform where you saw it.
segments.tr: - 誤解を招く投票情報は、地元の選挙管理事務所と、それを見たプラットフォームに報告してください。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: AI-generated media does not mean you can never trust what you see and hear.
segments.tr: AI生成メディアがあるからといって、目にするものや耳にするものを決して信じてはいけないというわけではありません。

segments.src: It means that a clip going viral is no longer enough evidence that it is real.
segments.tr: それは、バイラルになっているクリップが本物であるという証拠にはもはやならない、ということです。

segments.src: A few minutes of checking, from the right sources, remains one of the strongest protections voters have.
segments.tr: 適切なソースから数分かけて確認することは、有権者が持つ最も強力な保護手段の1つであり続けています。

de.title: Gefälschte Stimmen, echte Wahlen: Wie KI-Deepfakes die letzten Wochen der Midterms auf die Probe stellen

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3 approaching, voters are seeing more political audio, video and images online than ever.
segments.tr: Da der Wahltag am 3. November näher rückt, sehen Wähler online mehr politische Audio-, Video- und Bildinhalte als je zuvor.

segments.src: Some of it is real.
segments.tr: Einiges davon ist echt.

segments.src: Some of it is made by software that can imitate a person's voice or face in minutes.
segments.tr: Einiges davon wird von Software erstellt, die die Stimme oder das Gesicht einer Person in Minuten imitieren kann.

segments.src: Campaigns, social platforms and election officials are all working to respond.
segments.tr: Wahlkampfteams, soziale Plattformen und Wahlbehörden arbeiten alle daran, darauf zu reagieren.

segments.src: Here is what is going on, and what you can do before you share the next clip.
segments.tr: Hier erfahren Sie, was vor sich geht und was Sie tun können, bevor Sie den nächsten Clip teilen.

segments.src: ## Why this problem is growing
segments.tr: ## Warum dieses Problem wächst

segments.src: Synthetic media, often called "deepfakes," is audio, video or imagery generated or altered by artificial intelligence to make someone appear to say or do something they did not.
segments.tr: Synthetische Medien, oft als „Deepfakes“ bezeichnet, sind Audio-, Video- oder Bildinhalte, die von künstlicher Intelligenz generiert oder verändert wurden, um jemanden so darzustellen, als hätte er etwas gesagt oder getan, was er nicht getan hat.

segments.src: A few years ago, convincing fakes took specialized skills and expensive equipment.
segments.tr: Vor ein paar Jahren erforderten überzeugende Fälschungen spezielle Fähigkeiten und teure Ausrüstung.

segments.src: Today, many consumer tools can clone a voice from a short sample or produce a realistic image from a text prompt.
segments.tr: Heute können viele Verbrauchertools eine Stimme aus einer kurzen Probe klonen oder ein realistisches Bild aus einer Texteingabe erzeugen.

segments.src: That lower cost matters in election season for three reasons:
segments.tr: Diese geringeren Kosten sind in der Wahlsaison aus drei Gründen wichtig:

segments.src: - **Speed.** A fake can be made and posted in the time it takes news organizations to confirm whether something is real.
segments.tr: - **Geschwindigkeit.** Eine Fälschung kann in der Zeit erstellt und veröffentlicht werden, die Nachrichtenorganisationen benötigen, um zu bestätigen, ob etwas echt ist.

segments.src: - **Volume.** When anyone can make convincing content, the sheer amount of material makes it harder to check every item.
segments.tr: - **Volumen.** Wenn jeder überzeugende Inhalte erstellen kann, macht die schiere Menge an Material es schwieriger, jeden einzelnen Punkt zu überprüfen.

segments.src: - **Doubt.** Real recordings can now be dismissed as "probably AI." Experts sometimes call this the "liar's dividend," and it can erode trust even when nothing has been faked.
segments.tr: - **Zweifel.** Echte Aufnahmen können jetzt als „wahrscheinlich KI“ abgetan werden. Experten nennen dies manchmal die „Dividende des Lügners“, und sie kann das Vertrauen untergraben, selbst wenn nichts gefälscht wurde.

segments.src: ## What the threat looks like in practice
segments.tr: ## Wie die Bedrohung in der Praxis aussieht

segments.src: Most manipulated political content falls into a few categories:
segments.tr: Die meisten manipulierten politischen Inhalte fallen in einige wenige Kategorien:

segments.src: 1. **Voice clones in phone calls.** In January 2024, voters in New Hampshire received robocalls using an AI-generated imitation of President Biden's voice that urged them to skip the primary. The episode prompted a federal ruling that AI-generated voices in robocalls fall under existing restrictions on artificial or prerecorded calls.
segments.tr: 1. **Stimmenklone bei Telefonanrufen.** Im Januar 2024 erhielten Wähler in New Hampshire Robocalls, die eine KI-generierte Imitation der Stimme von Präsident Biden verwendeten und sie dazu drängten, die Vorwahlen auszulassen. Der Vorfall führte zu einer bundesweiten Entscheidung, dass KI-generierte Stimmen in Robocalls unter die bestehenden Beschränkungen für künstliche oder vorab aufgezeichnete Anrufe fallen.

segments.src: 2. **Altered video clips.** Real footage can be edited, slowed down, re-captioned or dubbed with a synthetic voice to change its meaning.
segments.tr: 2. **Veränderte Videoclips.** Echtes Filmmaterial kann bearbeitet, verlangsamt, neu untertitelt oder mit einer synthetischen Stimme synchronisiert werden, um seine Bedeutung zu verändern.

segments.src: 3. **Fabricated images.** Realistic pictures of events that never happened, such as crowds, arrests or endorsements, can spread quickly with a convincing caption.
segments.tr: 3. **Fabrizierte Bilder.** Realistische Bilder von Ereignissen, die nie stattgefunden haben, wie Menschenmengen, Verhaftungen oder Unterstützungsbekundungen, können sich mit einer überzeugenden Bildunterschrift schnell verbreiten.

segments.src: 4. **Misleading voting information.** Fake messages about polling hours, locations, deadlines or eligibility can target voters directly, sometimes by text or social media.
segments.tr: 4. **Irreführende Wahlinformationen.** Gefälschte Nachrichten über Wahllokale, Öffnungszeiten, Fristen oder Wahlberechtigung können Wähler direkt ansprechen, manchmal per SMS oder über soziale Medien.

segments.src: 5. **Parody that loses its label.** Satire is a protected and long-standing form of political speech, but a joke clip that is cropped or reposted without context can be mistaken for the real thing.
segments.tr: 5. **Parodie, die ihre Kennzeichnung verliert.** Satire ist eine geschützte und langjährige Form der politischen Rede, aber ein Witz-Clip, der zugeschnitten oder ohne Kontext erneut gepostet wird, kann für echt gehalten werden.

segments.src: Not every fake is designed to persuade.
segments.tr: Nicht jede Fälschung ist darauf ausgelegt, zu überzeugen.

segments.src: Some aim simply to confuse people, drain attention or leave them unsure what to believe.
segments.tr: Einige zielen einfach darauf ab, Menschen zu verwirren, Aufmerksamkeit abzuziehen oder sie im Unklaren darüber zu lassen, was sie glauben sollen.

segments.src: ## How campaigns, platforms and officials are responding
segments.tr: ## Wie Wahlkampfteams, Plattformen und Behörden reagieren

segments.src: **Campaigns and parties.** Many campaigns now monitor for false content about their candidates and prepare rapid responses.
segments.tr: **Wahlkampfteams und Parteien.** Viele Wahlkampfteams überwachen jetzt falsche Inhalte über ihre Kandidaten und bereiten schnelle Reaktionen vor.

segments.src: Some publish verified statements and videos on official channels so supporters have a trusted place to check.
segments.tr: Einige veröffentlichen verifizierte Erklärungen und Videos auf offiziellen Kanälen, damit Unterstützer eine vertrauenswürdige Anlaufstelle zur Überprüfung haben.

segments.src: Practices vary, and not every campaign discloses when it uses AI tools in its own materials.
segments.tr: Die Praktiken variieren, und nicht jedes Wahlkampfteam legt offen, wann es KI-Tools in seinen eigenen Materialien verwendet.

segments.src: **Platforms.** Major social networks and video sites have introduced policies on manipulated media, including labels for AI-generated content, requirements for creators to disclose realistic synthetic material, and removal of content that misleads people about how to vote.
segments.tr: **Plattformen.** Große soziale Netzwerke und Videoseiten haben Richtlinien für manipulierte Medien eingeführt, einschließlich Kennzeichnungen für KI-generierte Inhalte, Anforderungen an Ersteller, realistische synthetische Materialien offenzulegen, und die Entfernung von Inhalten, die Menschen darüber irreführen, wie sie wählen sollen.

segments.src: Enforcement is uneven, and content often spreads before it is labeled or removed.
segments.tr: Die Durchsetzung ist uneinheitlich, und Inhalte verbreiten sich oft, bevor sie gekennzeichnet oder entfernt werden.

segments.src: Many companies also support industry standards for attaching "content credentials," or provenance data, to files, though such data can be stripped when a file is re-uploaded or screenshotted.
segments.tr: Viele Unternehmen unterstützen auch Industriestandards für das Anfügen von „Inhaltsnachweisen“ oder Herkunftsdaten an Dateien, obwohl solche Daten entfernt werden können, wenn eine Datei erneut hochgeladen oder per Screenshot aufgenommen wird.

segments.src: **Election officials.** State and local election offices publish accurate voting information and often run "rumor control" pages that address common false claims.
segments.tr: **Wahlbehörden.** Staatliche und lokale Wahlbüros veröffentlichen genaue Wahlinformationen und betreiben oft „Gerüchtekontroll“-Seiten, die häufige falsche Behauptungen ansprechen.

segments.src: Many states have also passed laws that require disclosure of, or restrict, deceptive synthetic media in election communications, particularly close to an election.
segments.tr: Viele Bundesstaaten haben auch Gesetze verabschiedet, die die Offenlegung von täuschenden synthetischen Medien in der Wahlkommunikation vorschreiben oder einschränken, insbesondere kurz vor einer Wahl.

segments.src: The details differ from state to state, and some of these laws face legal challenges, so rules are not uniform nationwide.
segments.tr: Die Details unterscheiden sich von Bundesstaat zu Bundesstaat, und einige dieser Gesetze stehen vor rechtlichen Herausforderungen, daher sind die Regeln landesweit nicht einheitlich.

segments.src: **Regulators.** The Federal Communications Commission has said that AI-generated voices in robocalls are covered by existing telephone consumer protection rules.
segments.tr: **Regulierungsbehörden.** Die Federal Communications Commission hat erklärt, dass KI-generierte Stimmen in Robocalls von den bestehenden Regeln zum Schutz von Telefonverbrauchern abgedeckt sind.

segments.src: Beyond that, federal rules on AI in political advertising remain a subject of ongoing debate.
segments.tr: Darüber hinaus bleiben bundesweite Regeln für KI in der politischen Werbung Gegenstand laufender Debatten.

segments.src: ## How to spot manipulated content
segments.tr: ## Wie man manipulierte Inhalte erkennt

segments.src: No single test is foolproof, and the best fakes may look and sound flawless.
segments.tr: Kein einzelner Test ist narrensicher, und die besten Fälschungen können makellos aussehen und klingen.

segments.src: Treat the following as warning signs, not proof.
segments.tr: Betrachten Sie das Folgende als Warnsignale, nicht als Beweis.

segments.src: **Check the context first**
segments.tr: **Überprüfen Sie zuerst den Kontext**

segments.src: - **Who posted it?** An unknown or newly created account sharing a "leaked" or "shocking" clip deserves more caution than a verified outlet or official channel.
segments.tr: - **Wer hat es gepostet?** Ein unbekanntes oder neu erstelltes Konto, das einen „durchgesickerten“ oder „schockierenden“ Clip teilt, verdient mehr Vorsicht als ein verifiziertes Medium oder ein offizieller Kanal.

segments.src: - **Is there an original source?** Real events usually have multiple independent records: several camera angles, news coverage, official transcripts.
segments.tr: - **Gibt es eine Originalquelle?** Echte Ereignisse haben normalerweise mehrere unabhängige Aufzeichnungen: verschiedene Kamerawinkel, Nachrichtenberichterstattung, offizielle Transkripte.

segments.src: - **Does it trigger a strong emotion?** Content built to make you angry or afraid, and to be shared immediately, is a common pattern for misleading posts.
segments.tr: - **Löst es eine starke Emotion aus?** Inhalte, die darauf ausgelegt sind, Sie wütend oder ängstlich zu machen und sofort geteilt zu werden, sind ein häufiges Muster für irreführende Beiträge.

segments.src: - **Is the timing suspicious?** Explosive material that appears just before voting begins, with no time for checking, is a red flag.
segments.tr: - **Ist das Timing verdächtig?** Explosives Material, das kurz vor Beginn der Abstimmung erscheint, ohne Zeit zur Überprüfung, ist ein Warnsignal.

segments.src: **Look and listen closely**
segments.tr: **Schauen und hören Sie genau hin**

segments.src: - **Audio:** flat or oddly even tone, unnatural pauses, odd breathing, background noise that does not match the setting, or a voice that sounds slightly "too clean."
segments.tr: - **Audio:** flacher oder seltsam gleichmäßiger Ton, unnatürliche Pausen, seltsames Atmen, Hintergrundgeräusche, die nicht zur Umgebung passen, oder eine Stimme, die etwas „zu sauber“ klingt.

segments.src: - **Video:** mouth movements that do not line up with speech, blurry edges around the face or hair, inconsistent lighting, odd blinking, or hands and teeth that look distorted.
segments.tr: - **Video:** Mundbewegungen, die nicht mit der Sprache übereinstimmen, verschwommene Ränder um Gesicht oder Haare, inkonsistente Beleuchtung, seltsames Blinzeln oder Hände und Zähne, die verzerrt aussehen.

segments.src: - **Images:** garbled text on signs, extra or merged fingers, strange reflections, or repeated patterns in crowds.
segments.tr: - **Bilder:** unverständlicher Text auf Schildern, zusätzliche oder verschmolzene Finger, seltsame Reflexionen oder wiederholte Muster in Menschenmengen.

segments.src: - **Compression and cropping:** low-quality or heavily cropped clips can hide flaws, which is sometimes the point.
segments.tr: - **Kompression und Zuschneiden:** Clips von geringer Qualität oder stark zugeschnittene Clips können Fehler verbergen, was manchmal der Zweck ist.

segments.src: **Do a quick verification**
segments.tr: **Führen Sie eine schnelle Überprüfung durch**

segments.src: - Run a reverse image search on a still frame to see where else the image has appeared.
segments.tr: - Führen Sie eine umgekehrte Bildsuche für einen Standbildrahmen durch, um zu sehen, wo das Bild sonst noch erschienen ist.

segments.src: - Search for the quote or event along with the names of established news outlets or fact-checking organizations.
segments.tr: - Suchen Sie nach dem Zitat oder Ereignis zusammen mit den Namen etablierter Nachrichtenmedien oder Faktencheck-Organisationen.

segments.src: - Look for the full, unedited video rather than a short excerpt.
segments.tr: - Suchen Sie nach dem vollständigen, unbearbeiteten Video anstelle eines kurzen Ausschnitts.

segments.src: - Check whether the candidate's official website or verified social accounts have commented.
segments.tr: - Überprüfen Sie, ob die offizielle Website des Kandidaten oder verifizierte soziale Konten einen Kommentar abgegeben haben.

segments.src: ## Where to verify claims
segments.tr: ## Wo man Behauptungen überprüfen kann

segments.src: - **Your state or county election office.** For anything about registration, voting dates, polling places, mail ballots or ID requirements, go directly to your official state or local election website. Type the address yourself or use a trusted bookmark rather than clicking a link in a message.
segments.tr: - **Ihr staatliches oder lokales Wahlbüro.** Für alles, was Registrierung, Wahldaten, Wahllokale, Briefwahlunterlagen oder Ausweisanforderungen betrifft, gehen Sie direkt auf Ihre offizielle staatliche oder lokale Wahl-Website. Geben Sie die Adresse selbst ein oder verwenden Sie ein vertrauenswürdiges Lesezeichen, anstatt auf einen Link in einer Nachricht zu klicken.

segments.src: - **Vote.gov.** A federal government site that directs you to official state election information.
segments.tr: - **Vote.gov.** Eine Website der Bundesregierung, die Sie zu offiziellen staatlichen Wahlinformationen weiterleitet.

segments.src: - **Established fact-checking organizations.** Nonpartisan groups such as PolitiFact, FactCheck.org, and the fact-checking teams at major news agencies publish detailed reviews of viral claims.
segments.tr: - **Etablierte Faktencheck-Organisationen.** Überparteiliche Gruppen wie PolitiFact, FactCheck.org und die Faktencheck-Teams großer Nachrichtenagenturen veröffentlichen detaillierte Überprüfungen viraler Behauptungen.

segments.src: - **Wire services and local news.** Outlets such as the Associated Press and Reuters, along with local newsrooms that cover your area, typically confirm claims with multiple sources before publishing.
segments.tr: - **Nachrichtenagenturen und lokale Nachrichten.** Medien wie Associated Press und Reuters sowie lokale Nachrichtenredaktionen, die über Ihre Region berichten, bestätigen Behauptungen normalerweise mit mehreren Quellen, bevor sie sie veröffentlichen.

segments.src: - **Candidate and campaign channels.** If a quote seems out of character, see whether the candidate or campaign has addressed it on an official page. Keep in mind that a campaign also has an interest in how a story is framed, so compare with independent sources.
segments.tr: - **Kanäle von Kandidaten und Wahlkampfteams.** Wenn ein Zitat untypisch erscheint, prüfen Sie, ob der Kandidat oder das Wahlkampfteam es auf einer offiziellen Seite angesprochen hat. Denken Sie daran, dass ein Wahlkampfteam auch ein Interesse daran hat, wie eine Geschichte dargestellt wird, also vergleichen Sie sie mit unabhängigen Quellen.

segments.src: ## A simple habit before you share
segments.tr: ## Eine einfache Gewohnheit, bevor Sie teilen

segments.src: Try the **pause, check, then post** routine:
segments.tr: Versuchen Sie die Routine **innehalten, prüfen, dann posten**:

segments.src: 1. **Pause.** If something makes you instantly furious, delighted or alarmed, wait a few minutes.
segments.tr: 1. **Innehalten.** Wenn Sie etwas sofort wütend, erfreut oder alarmiert, warten Sie ein paar Minuten.

segments.src: 2. **Check.** Look for the original source and at least one independent confirmation.
segments.tr: 2. **Prüfen.** Suchen Sie nach der Originalquelle und mindestens einer unabhängigen Bestätigung.

segments.src: 3. **Post responsibly.** If you cannot verify it, do not share it. If you already shared something that turns out to be false, delete it or add a correction so others are not misled.
segments.tr: 3. **Verantwortungsbewusst posten.** Wenn Sie es nicht überprüfen können, teilen Sie es nicht. Wenn Sie bereits etwas geteilt haben, das sich als falsch herausstellt, löschen Sie es oder fügen Sie eine Korrektur hinzu, damit andere nicht in die Irre geführt werden.

segments.src: ## If you receive a suspicious call, text or message
segments.tr: ## Wenn Sie einen verdächtigen Anruf, eine SMS oder eine Nachricht erhalten

segments.src: - Do not rely on caller ID, which can be faked.
segments.tr: - Verlassen Sie sich nicht auf die Anrufer-ID, die gefälscht sein kann.

segments.src: - Hang up and look up the official phone number or website of the organization the message claims to come from.
segments.tr: - Legen Sie auf und suchen Sie die offizielle Telefonnummer oder Website der Organisation, von der die Nachricht angeblich stammt.

segments.src: - Never share personal information, passwords or payment details in response to an unexpected political or voting-related message.
segments.tr: - Geben Sie niemals persönliche Informationen, Passwörter oder Zahlungsdetails als Antwort auf eine unerwartete politische oder wahlbezogene Nachricht weiter.

segments.src: - Report misleading voting information to your local election office and to the platform where you saw it.
segments.tr: - Melden Sie irreführende Wahlinformationen an Ihr lokales Wahlbüro und an die Plattform, auf der Sie sie gesehen haben.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: AI-generated media does not mean you can never trust what you see and hear.
segments.tr: KI-generierte Medien bedeuten nicht, dass Sie dem, was Sie sehen und hören, niemals vertrauen können.

segments.src: It means that a clip going viral is no longer enough evidence that it is real.
segments.tr: Es bedeutet, dass ein Clip, der viral geht, kein ausreichender Beweis mehr dafür ist, dass er echt ist.

segments.src: A few minutes of checking, from the right sources, remains one of the strongest protections voters have.
segments.tr: Ein paar Minuten Überprüfung aus den richtigen Quellen bleiben einer der stärksten Schutzmechanismen, die Wähler haben.

segments.src: As the final weeks of the midterms unfold, being careful about what you share is one practical way to help keep the conversation about the election grounded in facts.
segments.tr: Während sich die letzten Wochen der Midterms entfalten, ist Vorsicht bei dem, was Sie teilen, eine praktische Möglichkeit, dazu beizutragen, die Diskussion über die Wahl auf Fakten zu stützen.

vi.title: Giọng nói giả, phiếu bầu thật: Cách AI Deepfake đang thử thách những tuần cuối của cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3 approaching, voters are seeing more political audio, video and images online than ever.
segments.tr: Với ngày bầu cử 3 tháng 11 đang đến gần, cử tri đang nhìn thấy nhiều âm thanh, video và hình ảnh chính trị trực tuyến hơn bao giờ hết.

segments.src: Some of it is real.
segments.tr: Một số trong đó là thật.

segments.src: Some of it is made by software that can imitate a person's voice or face in minutes.
segments.tr: Một số được tạo ra bởi phần mềm có thể bắt chước giọng nói hoặc khuôn mặt của một người chỉ trong vài phút.

segments.src: Campaigns, social platforms and election officials are all working to respond.
segments.tr: Các chiến dịch, nền tảng xã hội và các quan chức bầu cử đều đang nỗ lực để ứng phó.

segments.src: Here is what is going on, and what you can do before you share the next clip.
segments.tr: Dưới đây là những gì đang diễn ra và những gì bạn có thể làm trước khi chia sẻ đoạn clip tiếp theo.

segments.src: ## Why this problem is growing
segments.tr: ## Tại sao vấn đề này ngày càng gia tăng

segments.src: Synthetic media, often called "deepfakes," is audio, video or imagery generated or altered by artificial intelligence to make someone appear to say or do something they did not.
segments.tr: Phương tiện truyền thông tổng hợp, thường được gọi là "deepfake", là âm thanh, video hoặc hình ảnh được tạo ra hoặc thay đổi bởi trí tuệ nhân tạo để làm cho ai đó xuất hiện như thể đang nói hoặc làm điều gì đó mà họ không thực sự làm.

segments.src: A few years ago, convincing fakes took specialized skills and expensive equipment.
segments.tr: Vài năm trước, việc tạo ra các sản phẩm giả mạo thuyết phục đòi hỏi kỹ năng chuyên môn và thiết bị đắt tiền.

segments.src: Today, many consumer tools can clone a voice from a short sample or produce a realistic image from a text prompt.
segments.tr: Ngày nay, nhiều công cụ tiêu dùng có thể sao chép giọng nói từ một mẫu ngắn hoặc tạo ra một hình ảnh thực tế từ một câu lệnh văn bản.

segments.src: That lower cost matters in election season for three reasons:
segments.tr: Chi phí thấp hơn đó quan trọng trong mùa bầu cử vì ba lý do:

segments.src: - **Speed.** A fake can be made and posted in the time it takes news organizations to confirm whether something is real.
segments.tr: - **Tốc độ.** Một sản phẩm giả mạo có thể được tạo và đăng tải trong khoảng thời gian mà các tổ chức tin tức cần để xác nhận xem điều gì đó có thật hay không.

segments.src: - **Volume.** When anyone can make convincing content, the sheer amount of material makes it harder to check every item.
segments.tr: - **Khối lượng.** Khi bất kỳ ai cũng có thể tạo ra nội dung thuyết phục, số lượng tài liệu khổng lồ khiến việc kiểm tra từng mục trở nên khó khăn hơn.

segments.src: - **Doubt.** Real recordings can now be dismissed as "probably AI." Experts sometimes call this the "liar's dividend," and it can erode trust even when nothing has been faked.
segments.tr: - **Sự nghi ngờ.** Các bản ghi âm thật giờ đây có thể bị bác bỏ là "có lẽ là AI". Các chuyên gia đôi khi gọi đây là "cổ tức của kẻ nói dối", và nó có thể làm xói mòn niềm tin ngay cả khi không có gì bị làm giả.

segments.src: ## What the threat looks like in practice
segments.tr: ## Mối đe dọa trông như thế nào trong thực tế

segments.src: Most manipulated political content falls into a few categories:
segments.tr: Hầu hết các nội dung chính trị bị thao túng đều thuộc một vài danh mục:

segments.src: 1. **Voice clones in phone calls.** In January 2024, voters in New Hampshire received robocalls using an AI-generated imitation of President Biden's voice that urged them to skip the primary. The episode prompted a federal ruling that AI-generated voices in robocalls fall under existing restrictions on artificial or prerecorded calls.
segments.tr: 1. **Sao chép giọng nói trong các cuộc gọi điện thoại.** Vào tháng 1 năm 2024, cử tri ở New Hampshire đã nhận được các cuộc gọi tự động sử dụng giọng nói giả của Tổng thống Biden do AI tạo ra, thúc giục họ bỏ qua cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ. Sự việc này đã dẫn đến một phán quyết của liên bang rằng các giọng nói do AI tạo ra trong các cuộc gọi tự động thuộc phạm vi các hạn chế hiện có đối với các cuộc gọi nhân tạo hoặc được ghi âm trước.

segments.src: 2. **Altered video clips.** Real footage can be edited, slowed down, re-captioned or dubbed with a synthetic voice to change its meaning.
segments.tr: 2. **Các đoạn video bị thay đổi.** Các đoạn phim thật có thể được chỉnh sửa, làm chậm lại, thêm phụ đề hoặc lồng tiếng bằng giọng nói tổng hợp để thay đổi ý nghĩa của chúng.

segments.src: 3. **Fabricated images.** Realistic pictures of events that never happened, such as crowds, arrests or endorsements, can spread quickly with a convincing caption.
segments.tr: 3. **Hình ảnh bị làm giả.** Những bức ảnh thực tế về các sự kiện chưa bao giờ xảy ra, chẳng hạn như đám đông, các vụ bắt giữ hoặc sự ủng hộ, có thể lan truyền nhanh chóng với một chú thích thuyết phục.

segments.src: 4. **Misleading voting information.** Fake messages about polling hours, locations, deadlines or eligibility can target voters directly, sometimes by text or social media.
segments.tr: 4. **Thông tin bầu cử gây hiểu lầm.** Các tin nhắn giả mạo về giờ bỏ phiếu, địa điểm, thời hạn hoặc điều kiện đủ tư cách có thể nhắm trực tiếp vào cử tri, đôi khi qua tin nhắn văn bản hoặc mạng xã hội.

segments.src: 5. **Parody that loses its label.** Satire is a protected and long-standing form of political speech, but a joke clip that is cropped or reposted without context can be mistaken for the real thing.
segments.tr: 5. **Sự nhại lại bị mất nhãn dán.** Châm biếm là một hình thức ngôn luận chính trị được bảo vệ và có từ lâu đời, nhưng một đoạn clip hài hước bị cắt xén hoặc đăng lại mà không có ngữ cảnh có thể bị nhầm là sự thật.

segments.src: Not every fake is designed to persuade.
segments.tr: Không phải mọi sản phẩm giả mạo đều được thiết kế để thuyết phục.

segments.src: Some aim simply to confuse people, drain attention or leave them unsure what to believe.
segments.tr: Một số chỉ nhằm mục đích gây nhầm lẫn cho mọi người, làm tiêu hao sự chú ý hoặc khiến họ không chắc chắn về những gì nên tin.

segments.src: ## How campaigns, platforms and officials are responding
segments.tr: ## Cách các chiến dịch, nền tảng và quan chức đang phản ứng

segments.src: **Campaigns and parties.** Many campaigns now monitor for false content about their candidates and prepare rapid responses.
segments.tr: **Các chiến dịch và đảng phái.** Nhiều chiến dịch hiện nay theo dõi các nội dung sai lệch về ứng cử viên của họ và chuẩn bị các phản ứng nhanh chóng.

segments.src: Some publish verified statements and videos on official channels so supporters have a trusted place to check.
segments.tr: Một số công bố các tuyên bố và video đã được xác minh trên các kênh chính thức để những người ủng hộ có một nơi đáng tin cậy để kiểm tra.

segments.src: Practices vary, and not every campaign discloses when it uses AI tools in its own materials.
segments.tr: Các thực tiễn khác nhau, và không phải mọi chiến dịch đều tiết lộ khi họ sử dụng các công cụ AI trong tài liệu của riêng mình.

segments.src: **Platforms.** Major social networks and video sites have introduced policies on manipulated media, including labels for AI-generated content, requirements for creators to disclose realistic synthetic material, and removal of content that misleads people about how to vote.
segments.tr: **Các nền tảng.** Các mạng xã hội và trang web video lớn đã giới thiệu các chính sách về phương tiện truyền thông bị thao túng, bao gồm nhãn dán cho nội dung do AI tạo ra, yêu cầu người sáng tạo tiết lộ tài liệu tổng hợp thực tế và xóa nội dung gây hiểu lầm cho mọi người về cách bỏ phiếu.

segments.src: Enforcement is uneven, and content often spreads before it is labeled or removed.
segments.tr: Việc thực thi không đồng đều, và nội dung thường lan truyền trước khi nó được dán nhãn hoặc xóa bỏ.

segments.src: Many companies also support industry standards for attaching "content credentials," or provenance data, to files, though such data can be stripped when a file is re-uploaded or screenshotted.
segments.tr: Nhiều công ty cũng hỗ trợ các tiêu chuẩn ngành để đính kèm "thông tin xác thực nội dung", hoặc dữ liệu nguồn gốc, vào các tệp, mặc dù dữ liệu như vậy có thể bị xóa khi tệp được tải lên lại hoặc chụp ảnh màn hình.

segments.src: **Election officials.** State and local election offices publish accurate voting information and often run "rumor control" pages that address common false claims.
segments.tr: **Các quan chức bầu cử.** Các văn phòng bầu cử tiểu bang và địa phương công bố thông tin bầu cử chính xác và thường điều hành các trang "kiểm soát tin đồn" để giải quyết các tuyên bố sai lệch phổ biến.

segments.src: Many states have also passed laws that require disclosure of, or restrict, deceptive synthetic media in election communications, particularly close to an election.
segments.tr: Nhiều tiểu bang cũng đã thông qua các luật yêu cầu tiết lộ, hoặc hạn chế, các phương tiện truyền thông tổng hợp gây hiểu lầm trong các thông tin liên lạc bầu cử, đặc biệt là gần ngày bầu cử.

segments.src: The details differ from state to state, and some of these laws face legal challenges, so rules are not uniform nationwide.
segments.tr: Các chi tiết khác nhau tùy theo từng tiểu bang, và một số luật này phải đối mặt với các thách thức pháp lý, vì vậy các quy tắc không đồng nhất trên toàn quốc.

segments.src: **Regulators.** The Federal Communications Commission has said that AI-generated voices in robocalls are covered by existing telephone consumer protection rules.
segments.tr: **Các cơ quan quản lý.** Ủy ban Truyền thông Liên bang đã tuyên bố rằng các giọng nói do AI tạo ra trong các cuộc gọi tự động được bao gồm bởi các quy tắc bảo vệ người tiêu dùng điện thoại hiện có.

segments.src: Beyond that, federal rules on AI in political advertising remain a subject of ongoing debate.
segments.tr: Ngoài ra, các quy tắc liên bang về AI trong quảng cáo chính trị vẫn là một chủ đề đang được tranh luận.

segments.src: ## How to spot manipulated content
segments.tr: ## Cách phát hiện nội dung bị thao túng

segments.src: No single test is foolproof, and the best fakes may look and sound flawless.
segments.tr: Không có bài kiểm tra nào là hoàn hảo, và những sản phẩm giả mạo tốt nhất có thể trông và nghe hoàn hảo.

segments.src: Treat the following as warning signs, not proof.
segments.tr: Hãy coi những điều sau đây là dấu hiệu cảnh báo, không phải bằng chứng.

segments.src: **Check the context first**
segments.tr: **Kiểm tra ngữ cảnh trước**

segments.src: - **Who posted it?** An unknown or newly created account sharing a "leaked" or "shocking" clip deserves more caution than a verified outlet or official channel.
segments.tr: - **Ai đã đăng nó?** Một tài khoản không xác định hoặc mới được tạo chia sẻ một đoạn clip "bị rò rỉ" hoặc "gây sốc" xứng đáng nhận được sự thận trọng hơn một kênh chính thức hoặc nguồn tin đã được xác minh.

segments.src: - **Is there an original source?** Real events usually have multiple independent records: several camera angles, news coverage, official transcripts.
segments.tr: - **Có nguồn gốc ban đầu không?** Các sự kiện có thật thường có nhiều hồ sơ độc lập: nhiều góc máy quay, tin tức đưa tin, bản ghi chép chính thức.

segments.src: - **Does it trigger a strong emotion?** Content built to make you angry or afraid, and to be shared immediately, is a common pattern for misleading posts.
segments.tr: - **Nó có kích hoạt cảm xúc mạnh không?** Nội dung được xây dựng để làm bạn tức giận hoặc sợ hãi, và được chia sẻ ngay lập tức, là một mô hình phổ biến cho các bài đăng gây hiểu lầm.

segments.src: - **Is the timing suspicious?** Explosive material that appears just before voting begins, with no time for checking, is a red flag.
segments.tr: - **Thời điểm có đáng ngờ không?** Tài liệu gây bùng nổ xuất hiện ngay trước khi việc bỏ phiếu bắt đầu, không có thời gian để kiểm tra, là một dấu hiệu đỏ.

segments.src: **Look and listen closely**
segments.tr: **Nhìn và nghe kỹ**

segments.src: - **Audio:** flat or oddly even tone, unnatural pauses, odd breathing, background noise that does not match the setting, or a voice that sounds slightly "too clean."
segments.tr: - **Âm thanh:** tông giọng phẳng hoặc đều một cách kỳ lạ, tạm dừng không tự nhiên, hơi thở kỳ lạ, tiếng ồn nền không khớp với bối cảnh, hoặc giọng nói nghe có vẻ hơi "quá sạch".

segments.src: - **Video:** mouth movements that do not line up with speech, blurry edges around the face or hair, inconsistent lighting, odd blinking, or hands and teeth that look distorted.
segments.tr: - **Video:** chuyển động miệng không khớp với lời nói, các cạnh mờ xung quanh khuôn mặt hoặc tóc, ánh sáng không nhất quán, chớp mắt kỳ lạ, hoặc bàn tay và răng trông bị biến dạng.

segments.src: - **Images:** garbled text on signs, extra or merged fingers, strange reflections, or repeated patterns in crowds.
segments.tr: - **Hình ảnh:** văn bản bị méo trên các biển báo, ngón tay thừa hoặc bị dính vào nhau, phản chiếu kỳ lạ, hoặc các mẫu lặp lại trong đám đông.

segments.src: - **Compression and cropping:** low-quality or heavily cropped clips can hide flaws, which is sometimes the point.
segments.tr: - **Nén và cắt xén:** các đoạn clip chất lượng thấp hoặc bị cắt xén nặng có thể che giấu các lỗi, đôi khi đó chính là mục đích.

segments.src: **Do a quick verification**
segments.tr: **Thực hiện xác minh nhanh**

segments.src: - Run a reverse image search on a still frame to see where else the image has appeared.
segments.tr: - Chạy tìm kiếm hình ảnh ngược trên một khung hình tĩnh để xem hình ảnh đó đã xuất hiện ở đâu khác.

segments.src: - Search for the quote or event along with the names of established news outlets or fact-checking organizations.
segments.tr: - Tìm kiếm trích dẫn hoặc sự kiện cùng với tên của các tổ chức tin tức hoặc tổ chức kiểm tra sự thật đã được thiết lập.

segments.src: - Look for the full, unedited video rather than a short excerpt.
segments.tr: - Tìm video đầy đủ, chưa chỉnh sửa thay vì một đoạn trích ngắn.

segments.src: - Check whether the candidate's official website or verified social accounts have commented.
segments.tr: - Kiểm tra xem trang web chính thức hoặc các tài khoản xã hội đã được xác minh của ứng cử viên có bình luận gì không.

segments.src: ## Where to verify claims
segments.tr: ## Nơi để xác minh các tuyên bố

segments.src: - **Your state or county election office.** For anything about registration, voting dates, polling places, mail ballots or ID requirements, go directly to your official state or local election website. Type the address yourself or use a trusted bookmark rather than clicking a link in a message.
segments.tr: - **Văn phòng bầu cử tiểu bang hoặc quận của bạn.** Đối với bất cứ điều gì về đăng ký, ngày bỏ phiếu, địa điểm bỏ phiếu, phiếu bầu qua thư hoặc yêu cầu ID, hãy truy cập trực tiếp vào trang web bầu cử chính thức của tiểu bang hoặc địa phương của bạn. Tự nhập địa chỉ hoặc sử dụng dấu trang đáng tin cậy thay vì nhấp vào liên kết trong tin nhắn.

segments.src: - **Vote.gov.** A federal government site that directs you to official state election information.
segments.tr: - **Vote.gov.** Một trang web của chính phủ liên bang hướng dẫn bạn đến thông tin bầu cử chính thức của tiểu bang.

segments.src: - **Established fact-checking organizations.** Nonpartisan groups such as PolitiFact, FactCheck.org, and the fact-checking teams at major news agencies publish detailed reviews of viral claims.
segments.tr: - **Các tổ chức kiểm tra sự thật đã được thiết lập.** Các nhóm phi đảng phái như PolitiFact, FactCheck.org và các nhóm kiểm tra sự thật tại các cơ quan tin tức lớn xuất bản các đánh giá chi tiết về các tuyên bố lan truyền.

segments.src: - **Wire services and local news.** Outlets such as the Associated Press and Reuters, along with local newsrooms that cover your area, typically confirm claims with multiple sources before publishing.
segments.tr: - **Các dịch vụ tin tức và tin tức địa phương.** Các hãng tin như Associated Press và Reuters, cùng với các phòng tin tức địa phương đưa tin về khu vực của bạn, thường xác nhận các tuyên bố với nhiều nguồn trước khi xuất bản.

segments.src: - **Candidate and campaign channels.** If a quote seems out of character, see whether the candidate or campaign has addressed it on an official page. Keep in mind that a campaign also has an interest in how a story is framed, so compare with independent sources.
segments.tr: - **Các kênh của ứng cử viên và chiến dịch.** Nếu một trích dẫn có vẻ không đúng với tính cách, hãy xem liệu ứng cử viên hoặc chiến dịch có giải quyết nó trên một trang chính thức hay không. Hãy nhớ rằng một chiến dịch cũng có lợi ích trong cách một câu chuyện được định hình, vì vậy hãy so sánh với các nguồn độc lập.

segments.src: ## A simple habit before you share
segments.tr: ## Một thói quen đơn giản trước khi bạn chia sẻ

segments.src: Try the **pause, check, then post** routine:
segments.tr: Hãy thử thói quen **tạm dừng, kiểm tra, sau đó đăng**:

segments.src: 1. **Pause.** If something makes you instantly furious, delighted or alarmed, wait a few minutes.
segments.tr: 1. **Tạm dừng.** Nếu điều gì đó khiến bạn ngay lập tức tức giận, vui mừng hoặc lo lắng, hãy đợi vài phút.

segments.src: 2. **Check.** Look for the original source and at least one independent confirmation.
segments.tr: 2. **Kiểm tra.** Tìm kiếm nguồn gốc ban đầu và ít nhất một xác nhận độc lập.

segments.src: 3. **Post responsibly.** If you cannot verify it, do not share it. If you already shared something that turns out to be false, delete it or add a correction so others are not misled.
segments.tr: 3. **Đăng có trách nhiệm.** Nếu bạn không thể xác minh nó, đừng chia sẻ nó. Nếu bạn đã chia sẻ thứ gì đó hóa ra là sai, hãy xóa nó hoặc thêm một bản đính chính để người khác không bị hiểu lầm.

segments.src: ## If you receive a suspicious call, text or message
segments.tr: ## Nếu bạn nhận được một cuộc gọi, tin nhắn hoặc thông báo đáng ngờ

segments.src: - Do not rely on caller ID, which can be faked.
segments.tr: - Đừng dựa vào ID người gọi, vì nó có thể bị làm giả.

segments.src: - Hang up and look up the official phone number or website of the organization the message claims to come from.
segments.tr: - Hãy gác máy và tìm kiếm số điện thoại hoặc trang web chính thức của tổ chức mà tin nhắn tuyên bố là đến từ đó.

segments.src: - Never share personal information, passwords or payment details in response to an unexpected political or voting-related message.
segments.tr: - Không bao giờ chia sẻ thông tin cá nhân, mật khẩu hoặc chi tiết thanh toán để phản hồi một tin nhắn chính trị hoặc liên quan đến bầu cử bất ngờ.

segments.src: - Report misleading voting information to your local election office and to the platform where you saw it.
segments.tr: - Báo cáo thông tin bầu cử gây hiểu lầm cho văn phòng bầu cử địa phương của bạn và cho nền tảng nơi bạn đã nhìn thấy nó.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: AI-generated media does not mean you can never trust what you see and hear.
segments.tr: Phương tiện truyền thông do AI tạo ra không có nghĩa là bạn không bao giờ có thể tin tưởng vào những gì bạn thấy và nghe.

segments.src: It means that a clip going viral is no longer enough evidence that it is real.
segments.tr: Nó có nghĩa là một đoạn clip lan truyền không còn là bằng chứng đủ để chứng minh nó là thật.

segments.src: A few minutes of checking, from the right sources, remains one of the strongest protections voters have.
segments.tr: Vài phút kiểm tra, từ các nguồn đúng đắn, vẫn là một trong những biện pháp bảo vệ mạnh mẽ nhất mà cử tri có.

segments.src: As the final weeks of the midterms unfold, being careful about what you share is one practical way to help keep the conversation about the election grounded in facts.
segments.tr: Khi những tuần cuối của cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ diễn ra, việc cẩn thận về những gì bạn chia sẻ là một cách thiết thực để giúp giữ cho cuộc trò chuyện về cuộc bầu cử dựa trên sự thật.
